messages.author: befd01cbf4c68763
messages.subject: Error in vapply (g.list, graph_attr, character (1), "name")
parts:
Hello chris:

I am new to brainGraph 2.7 and I am having some problem with the section "8.4.1 Two-group difference"  since the error message tells me: "Error in vapply (g.list, graph_attr, character (1), "name"): values ​​must be of the 'character' type,
but the result FUN (X [[1]]) is of the 'integer' type ".

Attached part of the script:

covars.all <- fread(paste0('covars.csv'))
covars.fmri <- covars.all[fmri == 1, 1:4, with=F]
covars.fmri[, Study.ID := as.character(Study.ID)]
covars.fmri[, grupo := as.factor(grupo)]
covars.fmri[, edad := as.factor(edad)]
setkey(covars.fmri, grupo, Study.ID)
env.glm$covars.fmri<-covars.fmri
g.glm<-do.call(Map, c(c,g))[[1]]
con.mat <- matrix(c(0, -2), nrow=1, dimnames=list('Pre-cirugia /= Post-cirugia'))
brainGraph_GLM(g.glm, measure="E.nodal.wt", covars=env.glm$covars.fmri[,1:2], coding="effects", con.mat=con.mat, alt="greater")


I hope you can help me :(

messages.author: dadcb4fd6a01f8d1
messages.subject: Re: [brainGraph-help] Error in vapply (g.list, graph_attr, character (1), "name")
parts:
That error means that the graph-level "name" attributes for your graphs are integers, when they should be characters. This should not be a problem in future versions, but for now the simplest solution would be for you to make sure the "name" attribute is a character string.

Chris
